title: About GSFC University
content: GSFC University is located in Vadodara, Gujarat. It was established under the Gujarat Private Universities Act, 2009 by the GSFC Education Society, an initiative of Gujarat State Fertilizers and Chemicals Ltd, an industrial group over six decades old. The university is ISO 9001:2015 certified. Its vision is societal development through relevant and cutting-edge knowledge in frontier areas of professional growth.

title: University address and contact details
content: GSFC University, Vigyan Bhavan, P. O. Fertilizernagar, Vadodara - 391750, Gujarat, India. Phone: 0265-3093740 or 07573002444. Admission email: admission@gsfcuniversity.ac.in. WhatsApp: +91 7573002444. A full contact directory PDF is published under the Academics menu of the website.

title: Schools at GSFC University
content: The university has five schools: School of Information & Communication Technology (SoICT), School of Chemical Engineering & Fire Safety (SoCEFS), School of Chemical & Industrial Sciences (SoCIS), School of Life Sciences (SoLS), and School of Management & Entrepreneurship (SoM&E).

title: Programs in the School of Information & Communication Technology
content: The School of ICT (SoICT) offers: B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering, B.Tech. Electronics and Communication Engineering, Bachelor in Computer Application (BCA), M.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering, and Ph.D. Computer Science and Engineering.

title: Programs in the School of Chemical Engineering & Fire Safety
content: The School of Chemical Engineering & Fire Safety (SoCEFS) offers: B.Tech. Chemical Engineering, B.Tech. Fire and Environment, Health, Safety (Fire & EHS), and PG Diploma in Industrial Safety.

title: Programs in the School of Chemical & Industrial Sciences
content: The School of Chemical & Industrial Sciences (SoCIS) offers: B.Sc. (Hons.) Chemistry, Integrated BS-MS Pharmaceutical Science, Integrated B.Sc.-M.Sc. Chemistry, Integrated B.Sc. (H)-M.Sc. Data Science, M.Sc. Chemistry, M.Sc. Data Science, Ph.D. Chemistry, and Ph.D. Mathematics.

title: Programs in the School of Life Sciences
content: The School of Life Sciences (SoLS) offers: B.Sc. (Hons.) Biotechnology, B.Sc. (Hons.) Microbiology, M.Sc. Biotechnology, M.Sc. Microbiology, Ph.D. Biotechnology, and Ph.D. Microbiology.

title: Programs in the School of Management & Entrepreneurship
content: The School of Management & Entrepreneurship (SoM&E) offers: BBA / BBA (Hons.) General, BBA / BBA (Hons.) Business Analytics, B.Com. / B.Com. (Hons.), BBA-MBA Integrated with AI in Business, MBA (Business Analytics, Marketing, HR, Finance), and Ph.D. Management.

title: How to apply for admission
content: Students can apply through the Apply for Admission page of the university website, or submit an admission enquiry form. The Fee Structure for AY 2026-27 and the Admission Withdrawal and Fee Refund Policy for AY 2026-27 are published as PDFs under the Admission menu. Program-wise FAQ PDFs are also available there. For admission questions, email admission@gsfcuniversity.ac.in or call 0265-3093740 / 07573002444.

title: Where to find exam information
content: Examination policies, the exam time table and the Exam Cell contact details are published on the university website under the Exams menu. The university also runs an Online Exam Initiative (ONEI).

title: Academic calendar
content: The Academic Calendar for the odd semester of AY 2026-27 is published as a PDF under the Academics menu of the university website. The university follows the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) and offers a Minor Degree Program in Core Engineering and internships.

title: Hostel facilities
content: The university has hostels called Bhavans on campus: Kasturba Gandhi Bhavan (girls' hostel), Swami Vivekanand Bhavan (boys' hostel) and Vikram Sarabhai (boys' hostel). Details are on the Girl's Hostel and Boy's Hostel pages under the Admission menu.

title: Transportation
content: The university provides a transportation facility for students. Details are on the Transportation page under the Admission menu of the website.

title: Campus facilities
content: Campus facilities include: Hangout Area, FirePlex, Aanganva, Cultural Centre Auditorium, Auditorium, FoodPlex, HealthPlex, Library, Multi Sport Court, Pickleball Court, Medical Centre, Studio Room, SnacksPlex, MediPlex, conference rooms, girls' and boys' hostels. A 360-degree virtual tour of the campus is available on the website.

title: Student clubs and activities
content: Student life at GSFC University includes Student Managed Clubs, Student Managed Chapters, Vichar Vimarsh, Vartalap, PINUPS, sports, the National Cadet Corps (NCC) and Radio GSFCU, an internet radio station. Foundation Course and Practirience programs are also part of student life.

title: IEEE Student Branch
content: GSFC University has inaugurated an IEEE Student Branch, announced on 1 October 2026, to strengthen technology, innovation and global exposure for students.

title: Startup Expo on 12 October 2026
content: A Startup Expo is scheduled at GSFC University on 12 October 2026. More events are listed under Upcoming Events and Events@GSFCU on the website.

title: MoU with UEF, Vietnam
content: On 23 September 2026, GSFC University signed an MoU with UEF, Vietnam, strengthening India-Vietnam academic connect. The university also lists global engagement and academic collaborations on its website.

title: Placements
content: GSFC University reports 100 percent placement for the 2026 batch in B.Tech. Chemical Engineering, B.Tech. Fire & EHS Engineering and M.Sc. Chemistry, and 800+ placements overall. Recruiters listed on the website include Reliance Industries, Adani, Zydus, Nirma, UPL, Torrent Pharma, Alembic, GNFC, GSFC Limited, Atul Ltd, MRF, Weatherford, NielsenIQ and Netweb.

title: University at a glance
content: GSFC University has 3400+ students, 165+ faculty members, 21 programs, 45+ research labs, 200+ publications, 3000+ alumni and 900+ associations with industries, institutes and organisations. There were 1133 admissions for 2026-27 and 815 graduating students in 2025-26.

title: Academic initiatives
content: Initiatives at GSFC University include the Foundation Course, Online Teaching Initiative (ONTI), Online Exam Initiative (ONEI), PINUPS, Student Managed Clubs (SMC), Choice Based Credit System (CBCS), faculty internship and Internet Radio GSFCU.

title: Library
content: The university has a library with its own page on the website, and the university website links to library resources.
